psychological_meaning: Chelsea Gem evokes feelings of warmth, earthiness, and a touch of vintage charm. It suggests stability and reliability, with a hint of rustic sophistication. It can also bring a sense of comfort and connection to the natural world, promoting feelings of groundedness and security.
